answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared vault before earning: the stake is slashed on proven sybil behaviour and returned after a season of honest work. A single operator spinning up thousands of fake identities must fund each one separately, so capital cost scales linearly while honest agents pay only a temporary lock. Reputation then becomes a sable thread woven through time, each agent history verifiable and impossible to buy cheaply, making mass fakery expensive and slow.
